description: This script encodes firmware files for MOXA IW devices by adding headers, partitioning, and encrypting the data.

classes.name: Partition
classes.description: Data class representing a firmware partition with a name and size.

methods.name: xor
methods.description: Performs XOR encryption/decryption on data using a passphrase.

methods.name: add_fw_header
methods.description: Adds a firmware header to the data, including metadata and CRC.

methods.name: add_file_header
methods.description: Adds a file header with filename, size, and CRC.

methods.name: crc
methods.description: Calculates CRC32 checksum with an initial value.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main function that processes firmware partitions, adds headers, encrypts, and writes output.
